contentionBody: Another app now points the system proxy elsewhere. Kumo left it alone.
contentionBodyHolder: {holder} now holds the system proxy. Kumo left it alone.
contentionTitle: The system proxy was taken over
groupPreview: From the profile — start Kumo to switch nodes
heroTunDetail: Routes every app, including those that ignore proxies
profileDefaultHint: Routes everything directly. Import a subscription to use proxies.
profileNoUsage: This profile does not report usage.
profileRefreshFailed: The profile could not be refreshed
systemProxyFailed: The system proxy did not change
importDescription: Kumo checks that it is a Mihomo profile before adding it.
importFileHint: Choose a .yaml file. Kumo keeps its own copy, so moving the file later does no harm.
importUseProxyHint: For subscriptions blocked on your network.
importUseProxyStopped: Start Kumo to download through it.
profileDeleteBody: Its YAML and settings are removed from Kumo.
profileDeleteCurrent: It is in use: Kumo switches to the next profile.
profileDeleteFailed: The profile could not be deleted
profilesFooter: Switching profiles reloads Mihomo without dropping its process. Subscriptions update on the interval their provider sets.
proxiesEmptyHint: The current profile defines none. Import a subscription in Profiles.
proxiesNoMatchHint: Try part of a node's name or region.
proxiesPreview: Kumo is stopped: these groups come from the profile. Start Kumo to switch nodes and test delays.
topoError: The topology could not be drawn
topoSelectHint: Pick a member to use it.
aboutPrivacyLocalBody: Profiles, logs and settings never leave your device. Kumo has no account and no analytics.
aboutPrivacyNetwork: Talks only to what you add
aboutPrivacyNetworkBody: Kumo fetches your subscriptions, overrides, geo data and its own updates. Nothing else.
aboutPrivacyProxy: Leaves your system as it found it
aboutPrivacyProxyBody: On quit, even after a crash, Kumo stops the core and clears only the system proxy it set.
aboutTagline: A calm client for the Mihomo core.
aboutThanksBody: Mihomo, MyGo, Base UI, coss ui and React Flow.
aboutUpdatesDisabled: Updates are not available in this build
agentsCliHint: Agents drive Kumo through the kumo command. Every command can print JSON.
agentsIntro: Let a coding agent run Kumo for you: start the core, switch nodes, edit DNS or read logs. Install the command and the skill, then ask in plain words.
agentsPromptsHint: Every page has a prompt in its header that tells an agent how to do that page's tasks.
agentsSkillHint: Teaches agents the kumo commands and how to use them safely.
connectionsNoneHint: Connections appear here as apps use the proxy.
connectionsOff: Start the core to see connections
coreAllowLANHint: Other devices on your network can use this proxy.
coreControllerHint: Where Kumo and agents talk to the core.
coreControllerRestart: Changing the controller restarts the core.
coreFindProcessHint: Match rules by app. Strict looks up only when a rule needs it.
coreGeoDatHint: Off uses the smaller .mmdb database for GeoIP.
coreGeoHint: Country and site databases that GEOIP and GEOSITE rules match against.
coreMihomoHint: The binary Kumo runs. Automatic picks the newest one it finds.
coreMissing: No Mihomo found. Download one or choose a file.
coreMixedPortHint: HTTP and SOCKS on one port.
coreRequiredHint: This page reads from the running core.
dnsDefaultHint: Plain IP servers that resolve the hostnames of the servers below.
dnsDirectHint: Servers for direct connections. Empty uses the nameservers.
dnsEnhancedHint: Fake IP answers instantly and resolves at the proxy.
dnsFakeIPFilterHint: Domains that always get real addresses.
dnsFallbackFilterHint: When to trust the fallback servers over the nameservers.
dnsFallbackHint: Used when the fallback filter matches.
dnsListenHint: Serve DNS on this address. Empty turns it off.
dnsManagedOn: These settings replace the profile's DNS.
dnsNameserverHint: The main servers. Supports UDP, TCP, DoT, DoH and DoQ.
dnsPoliciesHint: Send some domains to specific servers.
dnsProxyServerHint: Resolve proxy hostnames. Empty uses the nameservers.
dnsRespectRulesHint: DNS queries follow the routing rules.
overrideDialogHint: YAML merges into every profile. JavaScript gets the config as `config` and returns it.
overridesIntro: Overrides apply to every profile, top to bottom.
overridesNoneHint: Add rules, DNS or nodes that every profile should have.
resourcesNoneHint: This profile doesn't use proxy or rule providers.
resourcesOff: Start the core to see providers
rulesOff: Start the core to see rules
settingsHideTrayHint: Takes effect after relaunch. Reopen Kumo from the Dock.
settingsQuitOnCloseHint: Otherwise Kumo keeps running in the menu bar.
settingsSetupHint: Walk through the first-run steps again.
settingsStartCoreHint: The system proxy follows if it was on.
setupAgentsBody: Install the Kumo skill so coding agents know how to drive it.
setupCliBody: The kumo command controls everything in this app from a terminal or an agent.
setupCoreBody: Kumo runs the Mihomo core. Use one you have or download the latest.
setupDoneBody: Start the core now, or later from the menu bar.
setupProfileBody: Paste a subscription URL, or import a file.
setupProxyBody: Kumo can point your system at the proxy while the core runs, and puts it back when it stops.
setupProxyHint: If another app takes it over, Kumo leaves it alone.
setupWelcomeBody: A calm home for the Mihomo core. A few steps and you're online.
showcaseAgentAsk: Switch to the fastest Japan node
snifferForceDNSHint: Also sniff connections whose address came from DNS mapping.
snifferForceDomainHint: Domains sniffed even when the connection has a hostname.
snifferManagedOn: These settings replace the profile's sniffer.
snifferOverrideHint: Route by the sniffed domain instead of the IP.
snifferPortsHint: Ports to sniff for each protocol.
snifferPureIPHint: Sniff connections that never had a hostname.
snifferSkipDomainHint: Never sniffed, such as apps that pin certificates.
spBypassHint: Hosts and networks that go direct.
spHowHint: Manual points apps at the mixed port. PAC lets a script decide per URL.
spPacHint: Kumo serves it on loopback. Return "PROXY" or "DIRECT" for each URL.
spReclaimHint: Off leaves another app's proxy in place and tells you.
tunAutoRedirectHint: Linux only. Faster TCP through nftables.
tunAutoRouteHint: Send all traffic through the TUN device.
tunExcludeHint: Networks that bypass the TUN device.
tunHijackHint: DNS queries to these addresses go to the core.
tunPermissionHint: TUN needs Mihomo to run with administrator rights. Kumo asks once for your password.
tunStackHint: Mixed uses the system stack for TCP and gVisor for UDP.
tunStrictHint: Stops leaks around the TUN device.
